/opt/tor-http-bridge/tor_http_bridge.py.sanitized_body:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""HTTP CONNECT bridge -> local Tor SOCKS5 (egress for rosstat containers).

Replaces the external OpenRouter relay (5.129.210.89:8888, service dead since
2026-08-22). Binds ONLY to the docker bridge gateway 172.18.0.1 so it is not
reachable from the internet. Requires the same Basic credentials clients
already send in RUSTATS_OPENROUTER_PROXY_URL.
"""
import asyncio
import base64
import sys

LISTEN_HOST = "172.18.0.1"
LISTEN_PORT = 8888
TOR_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
TOR_PORT = 9050
AUTH_USER = "<redacted>"
AUTH_PASS = "<redacted>"

EXPECTED_AUTH = (
    b"Basic " + base64.b64encode(f"{AUTH_USER}:{AUTH_PASS}".encode()).strip()
)

_SOCKS_ADDR_LEN = {1: 4, 4: 16}


def _log(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"[tor-http-bridge] {msg}", flush=True)


async def _pipe(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
    try:
        while True:
            chunk = await reader.read(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            writer.write(chunk)
            await writer.drain()
    except Exception:
        pass
    finally:
        try:
            writer.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


async def _socks_connect(host: str, port: int):
    reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(TOR_HOST, TOR_PORT)
    writer.write(b"\x05\x01\x00")
    await writer.drain()
    greeting = await reader.readexactly(2)
    if greeting != b"\x05\x00":
        raise RuntimeError(f"tor refused handshake: {greeting.hex()}")
    hb = host.encode()
    req = b"\x05\x01\x00\x03" + bytes([len(hb)]) + hb + port.to_bytes(2, "big")
    writer.write(req)
    await writer.drain()
    head = await reader.readexactly(4)
    if head[1] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"socks5 reply code {head[1]}")
    atyp = head[3]
    if atyp == 3:
        n = (await reader.readexactly(1))[0]
        await reader.readexactly(n + 2)
    elif atyp in _SOCKS_ADDR_LEN:
        await reader.readexactly(_SOCKS_ADDR_LEN[atyp] + 2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"socks5 odd ATYP {atyp}")
    return reader, writer


async def handle(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
    peer = writer.get_extra_info("peername")
    try:
        head = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
    except Exception:
        try:
            writer.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    request_line = head.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0].decode("latin-1", "replace")
    _log(f"{peer} HEAD {head[:400]!r}")
    parts = request_line.split()
    authorized = False
    for hdr in head.split(b"\r\n")[1:]:
        if b":" not in hdr:
            continue
        key, value = hdr.split(b":", 1)
        if key.strip().lower() == b"proxy-authorization":
            authorized = value.strip() == EXPECTED_AUTH

    if not authorized:
        _log(f"{peer} -> 407 ({request_line[:60]})")
        writer.write(
            b"HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authentication Required\r\n"
            b'Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="tor"\r\n'
            b"Content-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        )
        try:
            await writer.drain()
        except Exception:
            pass
        writer.close()
        return

    if len(parts) < 3 or parts[0].upper() != "CONNECT":
        _log(f"{peer} -> 501 ({request_line[:60]})")
        writer.write(
            b"HTTP/1.1 501 Not Implemented\r\n"
            b"Content-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        )
        try:
            await writer.drain()
        except Exception:
            pass
        writer.close()
        return

    target = parts[1]
    host, _, port_s = target.rpartition(":")
    try:
        port = int(port_s)
    except ValueError:
        port = 443

    try:
        socks_reader, socks_writer = await _socks_connect(host, port)
        writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 Connection established\r\n\r\n")
        await writer.drain()
        _log(f"{peer} tunnel {host}:{port}")
        up = asyncio.create_task(_pipe(reader, socks_writer))
        down = asyncio.create_task(_pipe(socks_reader, writer))
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(
            {up, down}, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED
        )
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
    except Exception as exc:
        _log(f"{peer} FAIL {host}:{port}: {exc}")
        try:
            writer.write(
                b"HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\r\n"
                b"Content-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
            )
            await writer.drain()
        except Exception:
            pass
    finally:
        try:
            writer.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


async def main() -> int:
    server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, LISTEN_HOST, LISTEN_PORT)
    _log(f"listening {LISTEN_HOST}:{LISTEN_PORT} -> tor {TOR_HOST}:{TOR_PORT}")
    async with server:
        await server.serve_forever()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
